items.title: ‘A playground, a beach, a home’: UNICEF demands end to child deaths in Russia-Ukraine war
items.summary: As Russia’s invasion of Ukraine continues, with both sides stepping up airstrikes and drone attacks in recent weeks deep inside each other's territory, the UN Children’s Fund (UNICEF) appealed on Tuesday for greater protection for the war’s youngest victims.

items.title: Afghanistan hunger crisis intensifies as millions left without food aid
items.summary: Afghanistan’s dire hunger crisis now affects 14 million people including babies fed on little more than weak tea and bread by their despairing and dirt-poor parents.

items.title: Africans bear the brunt of biodiversity loss
items.summary: For millions across Africa and the developing world, the biodiversity crisis is not an abstract problem – it’s the soil that no longer yields bountiful harvests and the fish that no longer return to coastal waters.

items.title: Gaza ‘unsafe for civilians’ as Israeli attacks hit homes and classrooms
items.summary: Gaza remains unsafe for civilians as Israeli attacks continue, including on schools and canvas classrooms, despite the October Israel-Hamas ceasefire that ended two years of war, the Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA) warned on Tuesday.

items.title: New Ebola vaccine trial launches as outbreak spreads in DR Congo
items.summary: Results may be months away, but efforts are advancing towards enhanced treatment and the world’s first vaccine for the Bundibugyo species of Ebola, the World Health Organization (WHO) said on Tuesday as deaths and cases rise in the largest ever outbreak on record in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC).

items.title: Strait of Hormuz disruption hits energy, fertilizer and industrial trade
items.summary: Disruption in the Strait of Hormuz has exposed the vulnerability of global trade to a single maritime chokepoint, with early data showing sharp falls in exports of energy, fertilizers and industrial products.

items.title: DR Congo: New centre opens at heart of record Ebola outbreak
items.summary: New UN-partnered centres will serve eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) as confirmed Ebola cases continued to climb sharply over the weekend in the largest-ever outbreak of the highly contagious disease in the country.

items.title: Drone strikes threaten civilians and aid operations in Sudan
items.summary: Drone strikes are posing deadly risks to civilians in Sudan and hampering humanitarian efforts to reach them as attacks continue to affect conflict-hit areas, the UN aid coordination office OCHA said on Monday.

items.title: In Somalia, AI is helping deliver food to hungry families
items.summary: Amid a deepening hunger crisis in Somalia, artificial intelligence (AI) is helping to deliver aid to the people who need it most.

items.title: Israel violates Lebanese airspace, kills over two dozen in Gaza in weekend strikes
items.summary: Israeli forces reportedly killed more than two dozen Palestinians in Gaza and violated Lebanese airspace more than 100 times over the weekend despite ongoing ceasefire agreements, UN agencies and peacekeepers said on Monday.

items.title: Mothers still lack support to breastfeed, UN warns
items.summary: Breastfeeding rates are rising worldwide, but millions of mothers and families still lack the services and protection they need to feed their babies safely, the UN has warned.
